summary.text: Craig Bowser is a Republican who has represented Kansas Senate District 1 in Jackson County since 2025.
He serves on the Agriculture and Natural Resources, Confirmation Oversight, Judiciary, Local Government, Transparency and Ethics, and Utilities committees.

paragraphs.text: According to his Kansas Legislature profile, Bowser's occupation is cyber security, and his spouse is Erin Bowser.

He is also a member of the Senate Select Committee on Veterans Affairs, the Joint Committee on Information Technology, the Joint Committee on State-Tribal Relations and special committees on taxation, telecommunications, and energy, utilities and telecommunications.
